library_entries

)

schema.name: listens
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE `listens` (

)

schema.name: people

)

schema.name: playback_positions
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE `playback_positions` (
  `person_id` text NOT NULL,
  `set_id` text NOT NULL REFERENCES `sets`(`id`),

  PRIMARY KEY (`person_id`, `set_id`)
)

schema.name: playlist_editors
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE `playlist_editors` (
  `playlist_id` text NOT NULL REFERENCES `playlists`(`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  `creator_id` text NOT NULL,
  `editor_id` text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`playlist_id`, `editor_id`)
)

schema.name: playlist_imports
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE `playlist_imports` (
  `id` text PRIMARY KEY,
  `person_id` text NOT NULL,
  `playlist_id` text NOT NULL,
  `source_playlist_id` text NOT NULL,
  `source_url` text NOT NULL,
  `state` text NOT NULL CHECK (`state` IN ('running', 'done', 'failed')),
  `page_token` text,
  `processed` integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `total` integer,
  `added` integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `unavailable` integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `over_limit` integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `downloading` integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `waiting` integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `failure` text,
  `created_at` integer NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` integer NOT NULL,
  CHECK ((`state` = 'failed') = (`failure` IS NOT NULL))
)

schema.name: playlist_sets

)

	`creator` text,
	`artwork_url` text,

	`listen_count` integer DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
	`finish_count` integer DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
	`last_listened_at` text
, `artwork_large_url` text, `released_at` text, `creator_id` text, `creator_url` text, `description` text, `genre` text, `source_chapters` text, `source_tags` text, `details_state` text DEFAULT 'pending' NOT NULL, `host_removed` integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `tracklist_state` text DEFAULT 'pending' NOT NULL, `tracklist_run_id` text, `tracklist_run_started_at` text)
